title: A nonlinear rod linkage model: zero-energy chains and continuum consistency
summary: We study a discrete Lagrangian model for a one-dimensional chain of rigid rods coupled by elastic springs. We characterize the geometry of its zero-energy constraint and distinguish the spinner and flipper regimes. Under graph-type hypotheses, selected zero-energy chains converge, after rescaling, to trajectories of an autonomous ordinary differential equation. For the physical linkage, we identify a simple alternating selection criterion under which chains form a unique monotone heteroclinic family in the spinner regime.
